name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 17 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-08-25, at wavelengths from 1.22 to 4.03 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
